metadata.body:
Adds Oracle Database Free as a reusable database-conformance backend. Oracle JDBC now runs through the OpenTelemetry Java agent and JDBC library instrumentation.

```yaml
runner: database-conformance
runner_config:
  backend: oracle
```

The Oracle scenarios cover statements, prepared statements, batches, and stored procedures. The backend waits up to three minutes for Oracle to start by default; set `OTEL_CONFORMANCE_ORACLE_STARTUP_TIMEOUT` to override the timeout.
